'''Quatermass''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Quatermass served in the [[Imperial Corrections Service]] aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] and was aboard it in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] when the barge broke down while en route to the [[detainment moon]] [[Gradient Seven]]. Quatermass was selected to be part of a boarding party that was to travel from the ''Purge'' to the nearby abandoned [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], to search for spare parts to try and repair the barge with. The team was led by [[Jareth Sartoris]] and made its way onto the Star Destroyer through a docking shaft. They then split into two, with Quatermass going off with a group under the command of the [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] [[Armitage]], along with his fellow engineer [[Phibes]] and a pair of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. However, Quatermass and the rest of the team contracted a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] that had infected the Star Destroyer, and [[Death/Legends|died]].
